name: Net Summary
description:
This module requires no configuration.
Shows an easy overview of the computer's network setup and connection status. This module displays basic information such as network adapters, IP address, gateway, DNS servers, and whether the connection is active. It helps quickly check if the computer is properly connected to the network and spot common problems.

Useful for quick checks, troubleshooting, and general system reviews.
